explanation: The response recognizes only the broad topic of temperature-dependent plasticity and names room temperature as a possible baseline. It does not reconstruct the studied materials, their single-crystal initial state, the 9–1373 K compression protocol, or the composition-dependent outcomes. Its generic appeal to microstructural evolution does not match the supported mechanisms of thermally activated glide, phonon-drag-controlled dislocation inertia, lattice-distortion/MSAD strengthening, and Cottrell-type dynamic solute pinning. The proposed in-situ TEM/XRD experiment could observe structural changes but would not cleanly discriminate the target mechanisms without CRSS, strain-rate sensitivity, serration, dissociation-width, and composition-dependent MSAD measurements.
